subject: Pilot gating items, pricing ballpark, and VP/CTO intro to unblock pilot
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Henderson <julia.henderson@starchain.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot gating items, pricing ballpark, and VP/CTO intro to unblock pilot

Hi Julia — great to meet today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum toward the pilot.

Call recap (high level)
- Goal: 6-week pilot to validate latency, cost, and quality for Starchain’s retrieval pipeline.
- Main constraints you called out: 1) on-prem data residency for logs, 2) SLA-dependent throughput for peak windows, 3) procurement lead time.

Open gating items we agreed to unblock:
1) Security docs: we’ll share a short SOC 2 summary and network architecture note (attached).
2) Exec alignment: one intro call between your CTO (or VP Eng) and our Head of Platform to confirm success criteria and timeline.
3) Procurement: a one-page commercial summary (pricing ballpark + typical reserved capacity paths).

Proposed next steps
- I attached a short demo agenda for the technical deep-dive (45 mins) and a SOC2 summary.
- Can we schedule the exec intro first (30–45 mins) to confirm timelines, then follow with the technical deep-dive (45–60 mins)?
- Suggested exec slots (PST): Tue Aug 25 10:00–10:45, Wed Aug 26 08:30–09:15, or Thu Aug 27 13:00–13:45.

Julia — can you confirm who from Starchain should be on the exec call (CTO, VP Eng, procurement lead)? If you prefer, I can send a Calendly link to lock one of the slots.

Ben — looping you in so you can own the technical deep-dive and draft the one-page pricing summary.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182
Redwood Inference — Inference that scales

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (3 pages), SOC2-summary.pdf (1 page)

From: Julia Henderson <julia.henderson@starchain.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Park <evan.park@starchain.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot gating items, pricing ballpark, and VP/CTO intro to unblock pilot

Hi Karthik — thanks for the clear recap and the attachments. Evan (cc'd) is our procurement lead and will need the one-page commercial summary.

On exec alignment: our CTO, Priya Mehra, can join but her calendar is tight. We have two windows that look promising next week (all ET):
- Tue Aug 25 13:00–13:45 ET (which is your Tue 10:00 PT)
- Wed Aug 26 11:00–11:45 ET (your Wed 08:00 PT — might be tight but possible)

For the technical deep-dive, Priya would prefer the exec handshake first, then a separate 45–60 min session with your engineers. She also asked for a ballpark range on monthly spend for a 3k-5k peak token/day workload and an estimate on lead time for a Private (VPC) deployment.

We can confirm final attendees after we land the exec slot. Evan — can you please share any procurement cadence or PO terms we should be aware of?

Best,
Julia Henderson
Head of Data Products | Starchain Labs
julia.henderson@starchain.com

Marissa, since this is a 6-week pilot request with VPC considerations, could you and I join that exec handshake to align on success metrics, timeline, and approved escalation path? Ben — can you draft the short pricing page (ballpark committed vs. burst) and a rough timeline for a Private deployment (lead time assumptions)?

Julia — to make scheduling easy I created a Calendly for the exec handshake: https://calendly.com/redwood/exec-handshake-45. If you confirm Tue Aug 25 13:00 ET we’ll lock it and I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda. Also happy to do a 10-minute pre-call internally 30 minutes before the exec if you’d like us aligned.

Questions outstanding for the agenda:
- Priya’s top success metrics (latency p95, end-to-end token cost threshold, uptime SLO).
- Data residency specifics for logs/metrics and whether an HSM/KMS integration is required.

If that all sounds good I’ll lock Tue 13:00 ET and Ben will circulate the pricing page by EOD.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
